name: Tempester n°45: Reverse Off clears every reverse store
explanation: Tempester n°45: Reverse Off clears every reverse store, so nothing stays reversed with the LED off (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: [routine](ctx, on) keeps one LED flag (ctx+0x26, LED 0x13) but two stores chosen by [routine] (the Pad Function mode): in 16 Beats / 16 Mutes the global [address] (XORed into each voice's reverse at its start, Timer 4), otherwise byte +0x37 of the selected beat ([address] + beat * 0x294), written into every recorded note ([routine]) and read for live pad play ([routine]). Off cleared only the store of the current mode and beat: Reverse on in a sound mode, change beat, Off: the first beat kept +0x37 = 1 with the LED off, and new recordings on it came out reversed; Reverse on in 16 Beats, change to a sound mode, Off: [address] stayed 1 and playback stayed reversed. +0x37 is not saved; only [routine], [routine] and [routine] cleared it. Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §6 (a). After: the Off branch, rewritten in place, clears [address] and +0x37 of the 16 beats (0-15), then clears the LED flag and the LED as before. On is unchanged. Not changed: [routine] (Timer 4) clears [address] without the LED (§6 (b), the LED can stay lit over forward playback in 16 Beats / 16 Mutes after a beat change). Context: main loop (UI). Byte stores, atomic for Timer 4. No RAM of its own, no free flash: 11 words in place, and the two words [address]-[address] (the old beat-mode tail of Off) are no longer reached.

edits.why: lui t0,0xa001 ; was "jal [address]": the Off branch no longer depends on the mode
sb zero,-0x6585(t0) ; [address] = 0: live reverse of 16 Beats / 16 Mutes
addiu t1,t0,0x2940 ; +0x37 of beat 16 (the undo copy, left alone): end
sb zero,-0x294(t0) ; delay slot: +0x37 of beats 0..15 = 0
nop ; was "addiu t5,t9,0x4a8c" | nop ; was "addu t4,t6,t5" | nop ; was "sb zero,0x37(t4)" (the current beat only); [address] clears ctx+0x26 and the LED as before
